about_the_game:
Embrace the darkness. Ascend to power.

The Great Gaias: Lord of Sorcery is a story-driven DLC expansion that puts you in control of Virgil Mythos, the enigmatic wizard who left the party in pursuit of magical training. After the brutal murder of his family, Virgil begins his descent into madness, pursuing vengeance, forbidden magic, and the means to reshape the world.

Experience the events of The Great Gaias from Virgil’s perspective as he takes the Test of the Adept, uncovers arcane secrets, and serves as the apprentice of the legendary Lord of Sorcery, Zacharael. Follow his path through shadow and sacrifice as he sheds his humanity and transforms into a being of terrifying magical might.

Once Virgil’s tale concludes, return to your main party and take on the Impossible Arena Challenge; a brutal endgame gauntlet featuring enhanced boss encounters, unique battle scenarios, powerful new gear upgrades, and brand-new skills for all 16 playable characters. Do you have what it takes to conquer the arena and master the battlefield?
